assumption: The ExitPlanMode hook records approver as human-via-exit-plan-mode because Claude Code's documented PostToolUse payload contains the approved plan but no human identity.
guidance: Superseded by the pivot: the ExitPlanMode PostToolUse hook is infeasible (no plan-mode hook fires, #21282), so approver-identity-from-payload never applies. Decision 0029's correction replaces it with CLI 'plan approve --by <name>', which carries explicit human identity. -> 0029-plan-approval-in-plan-mode.md
